get: getget[gɛt](verb 动词)1.■NOTE注：Get can meanmany things. We also use get in many phrases,the meanings of which depend on their context.For example, to get on could mean: make progress (Get on with your work); step on a bus (Get on before it goes); be friendly (They get on with each other); or become older (Grandad is getting on). All we can do here is to give a fewsynonyms for some of the main senses of get. *get有很多意义。我们也在很多短语里用get，其意义须视乎上下文而定。例如to get on可以指：使前进﹙Get on with your work继续做你的工作吧﹚；登上公共汽车﹙Get on before it goes在开车前上车﹚；友好﹙They get on with each other他们彼此很友好﹚；老起来﹙Grandad is getting on祖父年事日高﹚。此处只能按get的几个主要意义列出一些同义词而已。2.■得到What can I get for ￡10? 10英镑我能买到些什么呢？SYNONYM 同义词:acquire, be given, buy, come intopossession of, gain, get hold of, obtain, procure,purchase, receive.3.■和……接触Try to get him on the phone.想法打电话和他接触。SYNONYM 同义词:contact, get in touch with, speak to.4.■取来Go and get the ball.去把球捡来。SYNONYM 同义词:bring,fetch, pick up, retrieve.5.■得到She got a prize.她得了奖。SYNONYM 同义词:earn, take,win.6.■感染I got a cold.我患了感冒。SYNONYM 同义词:catch, contract,develop, suffer from.7.■捉到They got the thieves.他们捉到了贼。SYNONYM 同义词:apprehend, arrest, capture, catch.8.■说服Get someone to help.叫人来帮忙呀。SYNONYM 同义词:cause, persuade.9.■准备I’ll get tea.我去泡茶。SYNONYM 同义词:make ready,prepare.10.■懂I get what you mean.我懂你的意思。SYNONYM 同义词:comprehend, follow, grasp, understand.11.■到达When did you get here?你是什么时候到这里的？SYNONYM 同义词:arrive, reach.12.■来到How can I get home?我怎么回家？SYNONYM 同义词:come, go, travel.13.■变得It got cold.天冷了。SYNONYM 同义词:become, grow, turn.
